targets.claim: A gastrointestinal illness has affected about 100 people on the Celebrity Infinity cruise ship.
Both passengers and crew members have been affected.
The CDC has yet to determine the cause of the illness.
Two CDC staffers will meet the ship in San Diego on Monday to investigate further.
This is the third time the Celebrity Infinity has experienced such an outbreak.
The outbreak has led to increased cleaning and disinfection procedures.
Specimens have been taken from those afflicted for CDC testing.
